function placeRoots(roots): PlacedNode[]

Defined in: experiments/docs/arch-scene.ts:254

The manifest buckets hang off a synthetic center node — the portal root level IS the tree root, so the scene reads as one rooted graph (center = "In-depth project docs", ring 1 = the four buckets, …). Buckets are { root, label, children } — mapped to dir nodes here so they carry a real path (pickable + highlightable) and a real label. Shared by the three.js and scene3d arms.

Parameters

roots

object[]

Manifest root buckets.

Returns

PlacedNode[]

The flattened placed tree.
